diag and glance preserve the same private player-target output as diagnose (R1/R2/R3/R5e).

A target at 95% of maximum hit points reads "has a few scratches." through do_diagnose.
A target at 80% reads "has some small wounds and bruises.".

Reachable, but the port diverges, so it has no green. medit builds a mobile with zero hit dice (MAX(0, MIN(50, atoi)), src/medit.c:1036-1044) and C computes dice(num, size) + plus, which is 0 for a non-positive count (src/db.c:1748-1751; src/utils.c:66-77), so diag_char_to_char prints "is bleeding awfully from big wounds." (src/act.informative.c:359-381). The port prints "is in excellent condition" because NewMob (pkg/game/mob.go) invents hp = 100 when the dice are empty. Proof and reproduction are in the DP-1502 bundle PR body; the fix is one line in NewMob but it changes 20 tests that build hit-dice-less prototypes, so it needs its own change.
